notes.title: Trick or Treat...
notes.content:
Halloween 2022 

The spooky season is here, so why not carve a jack-o-lantern with the new Scythe melee? Kill 1,000 Zombies to make this weapon yours permanently!

And that's not all, grab the Eternal Dracula (White) Costume from the store to get an outfit with a permanent 10% HP Bonus!

Additionally for our F2P players, the Eternal Dracula (Black) costume is available in the Credit Store for 8,000 QGold! 

Aside from the amazing Halloween themed items & events, we have major updates for patch 1.0.32 as follows:

2 new systems
Wingman Drone system
Transformation Device

2 new armor sets
Experimental Prototype Armor
Dimension Cruiser Armor

1 New drone type
Pulsar MK3/MK4

3 new weapons
Legacy Styx 
Lightning QJY-88
Legacy Shadowburst 

3 new PvE maps
Chaotic Land (Critical Defense)
Lost City (Mass Biochemical Crisis)
The Shadow Palace (Threshold Defense)

Infinite Dimensions 
The first 15 layers of the infinite dimensions have been opened! These levels provide much greater challenge than nightmare difficulty! This comes with the Time And Space Essence and Time And Space Debris Shop! Along with a new set of armor and much more!

Quality of Life Changes
Drone levels and potential are no longer lost when gulping with $Gold

Quantum Reward Boxes: These boxes are now awarded for completing quantum realm stages. (15% Chance for a random weapon core, 85% chance for artifact chip)

Boss fragments, keycards, turret placements, and drone mods will no longer be globally announced in chat, this should reduce chat clutter

1 day versions of lvl 7 strong artifact weapons (Super Sunset, M132 Type X, Soul Howl) have been added to Fog Boxes (collection of lingyuan diji only)

Crystal Cell MK5/MK6 Blueprint has been added to the Platinum Gallery

New Daily/Weekly missions
New daily/Weekly missions have been added, along with a new mission for your first drone wingman!

PvP Balance Changes
M249 (All Variants)
Accuracy reduced 650 to 615 

MG3 (All variants)
Accuracy reduced from 635 to 605

M24 Frag Grenade
No longer affected by grenade pouch

Flash Grenades
Increased blind duration by 1.5s
Increased to 2 starting grenades (3 with Grenade Pouch)

Smoke Grenades
Increased to 3 starting grenades (4 with Grenade Pouch)

Effectiveness of Shrapnel Magnet II and Shrapnel Magnet III increased by 15% each.

Drone Balance Changes

MARS Drone firerate increased by 40%

Happy Haunting!

notes.title: Major Update (Patch Notes for 1.0.31 Update)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6587695/c430bea7ee0db0eff0ad2266c7f1e3123a877222.png[/img]

We are super excited to announce MARS major update today.  Maintenance scheduled to start at 23:00  ET  on Sept 12th.  Update will go live upon completion of maintenance. Patch notes as follows:

3 New Weapons
- M132 Type X (Never before seen custom weapon! Even in other versions!)
- Super Sunset Crossbow
- M67 Assault Grenade (Upgrade cores available in Credit Shop)

BattlePass Season 4
A new battlepass with the Endless Road mech suit as a reward at the end!

Super Chips
These weapon mods can be applied to super weapons to enhance your firepower! Available for rent in the in the store.

3 new PvE maps
- Burnt Bridges (Mass Biochemical Crisis)
- Jurassholes! (Extinction Ops)
- Shangri-Lost (Classic Mode)

1 new PvP map
- Isolation (Patient Zero)

Type III Perk Lootcases
These new lootcases contain perks that are stronger than their Type II counterparts. Available in the store.

2 new craftable turrets
HOD- Fire a giant laser down from the sky to deal massive damage to enemies and bosses! Blueprints for this perk can be obtained through Critical Defense boxes.

Nanobots- Your own personal swarm of killer robots! All blueprints for this are unlocked by default!

Drone Cases
Bumblebee MK3 and MK4 has been added to Drone Cases!


Bug Fixes
- Last Resort lighting bug fixed
- "The Dream Team" should now receive progress when The Quantum Realm is completed. (It must be all 12 waves, however the requirement has been reduced to be 2 clears instead of 3)
- Hero Mode achievements fixed
- Rewards section of the Battlepass has been updated to match the current season

Other Changes
Localization updates
Minimum players for The Quantum Realm has been reduced to 1 player.
Profanity filter updates
Legacy Kronos cores have been added to the Credit Store.

notes.title: New Game Mode Reveal - Open Beta Launch Reminder
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We have one last game mode to announce for Open Beta - Headhunter mode!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Rg3uSH3.png[/img]

Fight to have the biggest head and ego in this mode, where every kill makes your progressively larger, making you a bigger target!

If you manage to survive to the point of having the biggest head, you'll be temporarily invulnerable and have an OP weapon for several seconds!

A final reminder that the servers will be temporarily closed on Wednesday, Oct 20, at 10:00PM EST, as we prepare for Open Beta launch. The servers will be back up once Open Beta launches, on October 28, 2021, at 10:00AM EST.

If you haven't yet, don't forget to get your exclusive Panzer Dragoon Mk.2 while you still can! The Panzer Dragoon Mk.2 will [b]no longer be available[/b] once Open Beta launches.

You can get the Panzer Dragoon Mk.2 by purchasing the M.AR.S. Starter Pack on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1668180/MARS_Starter_Pack/

We will also have founders packages available for purchase in the in-game $gold store on the launch of Open Beta, which will only be available for 90 days:

I ain't 'fraid of no ghosts!

notes.title: Player Feedback and Starter Pack!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings to all Players and Fans![/b]

We’ve received a ton of great feedback from all of you over the last few months of development and Beta testing, and especially so in the last few days since our Steam Early Access launch!

First and foremost, we’d like to make it well known that we take everyone’s comments seriously! And even the smallest complaint is taken into consideration on how to make M.A.R.S. the best it can be!

And so that brings us to one of the complaints we’ve heard a lot so far; the VIP system. 

We know that the VIP System is a hot topic when discussed amongst our Players, but we want to make it as transparent as possible that we understand the cautious negatives that some of our players are bringing up, and so we’ve released a special Starter Pack on Steam to remedy this! Details for Starter Pack here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1668180/MARS_Starter_Pack/?beta=0

90-Days of VIP alone is worth the price of the Starter Pack. But as an added incentive, we have included many more goodies that we believe are essential to a new player’s ideal experience, including some items that can’t be purchased normally!

This pack is limited to 1 purchase per person. And to dissuade any worries about buying stuff during an Early Access; all players who purchase the pack will also receive the same contents once more after we release into Full Release and again if there are to be any Server Wipes.

As a final thank you to cap off this announcement, for a limited time, we included an Exclusive Golden Panzer Dragoon in this Starter pack. This Drone is equivalent in Stats to other Drones within M.A.R.S., though it comes with a unique gilded design that will never be available again once Early Access Ends.

So if you’re in the camp of players cautiously wary about the VIP Cards, we hope this works to alleviate your concerns! And if you're not in that camp, well then we hope you enjoy the value and savings!

Details for Starter Pack here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6587695/c3eb24f4bd4822afedbfbb6c4f79bbdfa04654c9.gif[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1668180/MARS_Starter_Pack/?beta=0
PS: This pack is on 80% Off from now - July 8th during the Steam Sale period

notes.title: The wait is finally over!
notes.content:
After months of hard work we’re finally ready to release on Steam! And Release is coming fast! TOMORROW! 

That’s right, in less than 24 Hours, the M.A.R.S. Prologue will be available for download! For the players that are completely new, this version of M.A.R.S. is an Early Access Beta containing a brief introduction to what our full release has to offer! 

The Prologue is a step forward with our extensive Closed Beta testing! During which we will be closely monitoring balance and feedback all around! After all, this IS a Beta, and so testing is our main priority!
   
But we want it to be yours too! And so we’re giving all players $200 worth of in-game premium currency with which to buy as much as they want and play around with everything! All in the name of science and testing, of course.

Lastly, all players who reach the following levels throughout the duration of our Prologue Beta testing will receive exclusive rewards for the full release!

notes.title: Patch Update
notes.content:
Please be advised that servers will be down between 12:00 am - 2:00 am (EST/GMT -5) on Feb 10th, 2021 for patch update.  

Patch Notes:

- Players should now received gun mods upon reaching the appropriate levels. Please let us know if this is still not the case.
- PVE Battlepass missions have been added.
- Higher Tier drones can now be crafted again by dismantling lower tier drones.
- Daily missions should now be available again.Please let us know if this is still not the case.
- An issue with the Lost Mountain map not giving EXP and gold has been fixed.
- An issue with the Minesweeper map having an invisible wall in round 3 has been fixed.
- An issue with the Mercy Killing Map where you cannot shoot through a specific window has been fixed.
- Daily missions should now give 10 silver bullets, from 1 silver bullet.
- All x5 and x2 cards have been temporarily removed, as we resolve an issue with them.
- The issue with the Mean Streets map has been resolved, and is now playable again.
- More weapons have been added to the cash shop.
- The gifting function of $gold items has been temporarily removed.
- An Issue with the subtitles of the Waste Management map has been fixed.

We have received your reports on many issues, and they are still being fixed. Thank you for your continued support, and please continue to submit any new bugs and suggestions you find!

notes.title: M.A.R.S. Game Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6587695/65f9f1c4a7d096f779725f9dab38cf482f44b6e7.jpg[/img]A huge thanks to everyone who has reported issues so far! We will be having a maintenance at 9PM EST today to update the game.

Patch notes for the update are as follows:

- Localization updates
- Beta NPC in the tutorial should no longer T-Pose when being revived
- Death timer in PVP modes has been reduced to 3 seconds
- Drone Icon in PVE has been moved to be beside the health bar.
- Daily Missions should now be appearing again.
- Daily missions now give 10 silver bullets as intended.
- An issue with buying levels for the Battlepass has been fixed.
- Guild Names should now be unique. Existing duplicate guild names have an extra number attached to them (e.g. SesameStreet, SesameStreet2, SesameStreet3, etc.).
- Monster pathing to unreachable areas have been fixed.
- Lost Mountain giving 0 exp and gold has been fixed.
- The Results Screen sometimes not showing gained exp and gold has been fixed.
- Quantum Channel 1 rooms should now allow the full 8 players
- Password-Locked lobbies no longer need 3 players.
- Disconnections in matches should be resolved. Please let us know if this continues to be an issue.
- Assault/TEK weapons weapon effects should now work.
- Players should now received gun mods upon reaching the appropriate levels. Please let us know if this is not the case.

PS: For any of you that have yet to add M.A.R.S. to wish list, please smash that wish list button and show your love!

Ending Time: 24:00 EST (GMT -5 hours)

Canadians are known to be some of the most polite, tactful, and peace-loving human beings on the planet. A stereotypical Canadian is depicted as one who apologizes despite not being at fault. To a certain extent, this is true. Try live streaming alongside this overly polite crowd and see if that is the case....

Starting Time: 19:00 EST (GMT -5 hours)
Ending Time: 22:00 EST (GMT -5 hours) 

[b]Third time's the charm[/b]
Holiday shopping prevented you from joining the above time slots? We get it! How about skipping the crowd anywhere and chillax on a great Saturday afternoon...?

Date: Dec 19th, 2020
Starting Time: 17:00 EST (GMT -5 hours)
Ending Time: 22:00 EST (GMT -5 hours) 

[b]Fashionably Late[/b]
None of that works for you? Hey no worries! It's better late than never.  Talk about new year resolution, you've got year 2020 - year 2021 to think over this. 

Date: Dec 20th, 2020 - Jan 14th, 2021

Ending Time: Whenever you want 

Look forward to seeing you in any one or more of the above time slots! Be there or be square!
